reviewContract.pixelReviewed: The shipped file was inspected at native card size, not inferred from its filename or prompt.
reviewContract.cardCrop: Subject identity and important details remain readable in the rectangular portrait card.
reviewContract.radarCrop: Eyes, face, and identity cues remain readable with Portrait focus=face and object-position center 18%.

dwarf-female.notes: Clearly female and Dwarven at card size; robust proportions, mountain-citadel setting, master-crafted armor, and a shorter ornamented beard with metal and gem details. Replaces the human-male-reading studio portrait reported in GitHub issue 107.

s-kra-mur-female.notes: Clearly reptilian at native card size and in the face crop: continuous scales, slit pupil, non-mammalian cranial structure, and a visible snout. Feminine costuming does not replace species anatomy. Reviewed beside s-kra-mur-male.webp.

prydaen-male.notes: Clearly feline at native card size and in the face crop: full facial fur, muzzle, feline nose, slit pupils, mobile ears, and mane remain visible without relying on costume. Reviewed beside prydaen-female.webp.

gor-tog-female.notes: Green skin, heavy facial structure, thick neck, and broad powerful shoulders read as Gor'Tog at both runtime crops. Both visible ears are rounded with no elf-like point. Reviewed beside gor-tog-male.webp.

contactSheetReview.scope: All 22 core race/sex defaults in public/portraits/manifest.json

dwarf.notes: Both read as compact, robust mountain Dwarves; the female replacement also passed its dedicated card and radar crop review.

elf.notes: Both retain the shared long-eared, fine-featured Elven read at card size despite different camera distances.

elothean.notes: Both share the high-forehead, restrained, scholarly Elothean visual language; neither is confused with a non-human anatomy class.

gnome.notes: Both read as the same small-statured, large-eyed Gnome population in the runtime crops.

gor-tog.notes: Both show green skin, rounded ears, heavy builds, and body-revealing framing. The female replacement also passed dedicated card and radar crop review.

halfling.notes: Both retain a small-statured Halfling read and coherent pastoral material language.

human.notes: Both provide neutral Human defaults without borrowing the defining anatomy of another playable race.

kaldar.notes: Both carry the tall, martial Kaldaran presentation; lighting and costume vary without changing the underlying people.

prydaen.notes: Both are unmistakably furred and feline with visible muzzles, feline ears, and mane language. The male replacement passed dedicated card and radar crop review.

rakash.notes: The Human-like female and moonskin male are an intentional display of Rakash form variation, not a species-fidelity failure.

s-kra-mur.notes: Both are unmistakably scaled and reptilian with non-mammalian head structures. The female replacement passed dedicated card and radar crop review.

contactSheetReview.notes: All core defaults were inspected together from the shipped pixels. Pair approval records species identity; changed assets additionally carry immutable hashes and explicit card/radar crop results above.
